WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    `ANA Pattern`,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_averages
  FROM group_averages
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.`ANA Pattern` as pattern,
    ga.avg_acl_igg,
    om.mean_of_averages
  FROM group_averages ga
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ga.avg_acl_igg > om.mean_of_averages
),
kept_patterns_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_kept
  FROM above_mean
)
SELECT 
  am.pattern,
  ROUND(am.avg_acl_igg, 2) as avg_acl_igg,
  ROUND(am.avg_acl_igg - am.mean_of_averages, 2) as above_overall_mean,
  ROUND(am.avg_acl_igg - kpm.mean_of_kept, 2) as from_kept_mean
FROM above_mean am
CROSS JOIN kept_patterns_mean kpm
ORDER BY am.avg_acl_igg DESC
